name: Autocannon Belt (Junction)
description: Autocannon belts can transfer all calibers of autocannon ammo. Junction belts redirect the path of ammo transfer.

logicNodes.label: Junction Switch
logicNodes.description: Switches the ammo transfer T-junction between the left and right sides.

logicNodes.label: Contains Ammo
logicNodes.description: Returns true if the belt contains a shell.
